scope: Six branch-local formal batches only; E1 objective, E2 resource masks, E3 A deployment, E4a deadlines, E4b requests, E4b construction fallback pair.
excluded: No main K178/K196, H02 research, mock precheck calls or failed precheck01 recipe counted as formal research.
collection: Read-only JSON/file hash/arithmetic inventory; no planner, schedule validator, thermal kernel, MATLAB or Git used.
budget_interpretation: Declared maxima, consumed once-only call allocation, actual root elapsed and batch wall are distinct; unused post quotas are not actual calls.

kernel_consistency.scope_note: Same original physical/thermal/numerical/legality kernel and original HEFT body. Experimental masks/deployment/deadline/copy problem domains differ explicitly; this is not a claim all six mathematical problems are identical.

algorithm_version_note: E1 through E4 requests retain the same E1 score-view search. Final pair first arm retains it and second adds one default-EFT deadline-ready construction only when original four return no complete legal candidate. This is a method adaptation, not the original HEFT or MILP.
